address: Marygreen Manor Hotel, London Road, Brentwood, Essex,CM14 4NR
bio: Why not treat yourself to a delicious Afternoon Tea in the AA Rosette winning Tudors Restaurant at Mary Green Manor. Indulge in the great British tradition in this grand 16th century building.  Afternoon Tea is served in the lounge or the conservatory area which is decorated in traditional Tudor furnishing and provides a peaceful environment for diners to enjoy their meal.  Their menu consists of a number of quintessential features of an afternoon tea such as dainty finger sandwiches and succulent scones.  Tudors Restaurant is located in the heart of Essex, just a short drive away from Lakeside shopping centre.
